kings1.15.p1.b1.text: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijam became king of Judah, and he reigned in Jerusalem three years.

kings1.15.p1.b2.text: …his heart was not as fully devoted to the LORD his God as the heart of David his forefather had been.

kings1.15.p1.b3.text: Nevertheless, for the sake of David, the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem…

kings1.15.p1.b4.text: And Abijam rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David, and his son Asa reigned in his place.

kings1.15.p2.b1.text: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam’s reign over Israel, Asa became king of Judah, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years.

kings1.15.p2.b2.text: And Asa did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, as his father David had done.

kings1.15.p2.b3.text: …and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

kings1.15.p3.b1.text: He also removed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother because she had made a detestable Asherah pole.

kings1.15.p3.b2.text: Asa chopped down the pole and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

kings1.15.p3.b3.text: The high places were not removed, but Asa’s heart was fully devoted to the LORD all his days.

kings1.15.p4.b1.text: Baasha king of Israel went to war against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.

kings1.15.p4.b2.text: “…See, I have sent you a gift of silver and gold. Now go and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he will withdraw from me.”

kings1.15.p4.b3.text: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel…

kings1.15.p4.b4.text: Then King Asa summoned all the men of Judah, with no exceptions…

kings1.15.p5.b1.text: …In his old age, however, he became diseased in his feet.

kings1.15.p5.b2.text: And Asa rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the city of his father David, and his son Jehoshaphat reigned in his place.

kings1.15.p5.b3.text: In the second year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel, and he reigned two years.

kings1.15.p5.b4.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and walked in the way of his father…

kings1.15.p6.b1.text: Then Baasha son of Ahijah of the house of Issachar conspired against Nadab, and Baasha struck him down at Gibbethon of the Philistines…

kings1.15.p6.b2.text: In the third year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Baasha killed Nadab and reigned in his place.

kings1.15.p6.b3.text: As soon as Baasha became king, he struck down the entire household of Jeroboam… according to the word that the LORD had spoken through His servant Ahijah the Shilonite…

kings1.15.p6.b4.text: In the third year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah twenty-four years.
